meta.name: boardroom
meta.description: /cs:boardroom <brief> — 6-phase multi-role deliberation across the C-suite with Phase 2 isolation, critic pre-screen, and synthesis. Outputs a board memo. Use when a decision spans multiple executive domains — e.g. a pricing change touching finance, positioning, and product, or a raise-vs-cut runway call.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 模拟高管团队进行多角色决策讨论并生成纪要
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要模拟C-level讨论来辅助复杂决策
copy.tagline_en: Simulate C-suite deliberation across roles and generate a board memo
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need multi-role executive deliberation to support complex decisions

howto.what: Claude 模拟一个董事会会议，让多位高管角色（如CFO、CTO等）独立分析问题，然后交叉讨论、提出反对意见，最后生成一份董事会备忘录，包含投票结果、异议和决策建议。
howto.when: 当你需要做跨多个业务领域的决策时，例如定价调整涉及财务、定位和产品，或者融资决策涉及增长与削减成本。

say.text: 用 /cs:boardroom 分析我们是否应该涨价20%。
say.note: Claude 会启动6阶段董事会讨论，输出备忘录。

say.text: 运行 /cs:boardroom 评估裁员还是冻结招聘。
say.note: Claude 会模拟高管团队讨论，给出建议。

howto.what_en: Claude simulates a board meeting with multiple C-suite roles (e.g., CFO, CTO) who independently analyze a brief, then cross-examine each other, surface dissents, and produce a board memo with votes, concerns, and a recommended decision path.
howto.when_en: When you face a decision spanning multiple executive domains, such as a pricing change affecting finance, positioning, and product, or a raise-vs-cut runway call.

say_en.text: Run /cs:boardroom to analyze whether we should raise prices by 20%.
say_en.note: Claude will run the 6-phase deliberation and output a memo.

say_en.text: Execute /cs:boardroom to evaluate layoffs vs hiring freeze.
say_en.note: Claude will simulate the C-suite discussion and give a recommendation.
